backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing user profiles, book catalog, book preferences, and sell request management with authorization and blob storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting implemented features including login button styling, book preferences, sample books display, sell book functionality, and menu navigation.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend components, hooks, and configuration files describing their purpose and functionality.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH-based color system defining light and dark theme variables for botanical design palette.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with page title 'Kitabi Keeda' and root div for React application mounting.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main application component orchestrating hero section, search, book preferences, sample books, sell modal, and book catalog with authentication-aware rendering.
frontend/src/components/AddBookForm.tsx: Admin-only form component for adding books to catalog with image upload, progress tracking, and form validation.
frontend/src/components/BookCard.tsx: Book display card component showing cover image, title, author, and price with hover effects and botanical theme styling.
frontend/src/components/BookCatalog.tsx: Displays a grid of books from the catalog with loading, error, and empty states. Filters books by search term matching title or author.
Allows users to select favorite book genres from a predefined list and save their preferences. Uses checkboxes and displays loading/saving states.
frontend/src/components/CameraCapture.ts: Provides camera functionality to capture photos with support for switching between front/back cameras. Handles camera permissions, errors, and converts captured images to ExternalBlob format.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with company info, contact details, social media links, and attribution to caffeine.ai. Displays current year dynamically.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout wrapper component that includes Navigation header, main content area, and Footer. Provides consistent page structure across the app.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Handles Internet Identity authentication with login/logout functionality. Clears query cache on logout and manages loading states.
frontend/src/components/MenuDropdown.tsx: Dropdown menu component with Settings, Personalization, and Browse Catalog options. Uses shadcn/ui dropdown components with custom styling.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Sticky header navigation with logo, menu links, and login button. Includes responsive mobile menu and decorative leaf pattern background.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog that prompts new users to enter their name on first login. Prevents closing until profile is saved.
frontend/src/components/SampleBooks.tsx: Displays a grid of sample books fetched via useGetSampleBooks hook, showing book covers, titles, authors, and prices with loading and error states.
frontend/src/components/SearchBar.tsx: Search input component with integrated voice search button and clear functionality, accepting value and onChange props for controlled input.
frontend/src/components/SellBookForm.tsx: Form component for submitting book sell requests with fields for title, author, price, and cover image upload (file or camera capture) with progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/SellBookModal.ts: Dialog modal wrapper that displays the SellBookForm component with header and description for selling books.
frontend/src/components/VoiceSearchButto: Button component that toggles voice search using the useVoiceSearch hook, displaying mic icon with visual feedback during listening state.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that manages the backend actor instance with authentication via Internet Identity, initializing access control and invalidating dependent queries on actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for backend operations including user profiles, book preferences, sample books, sell requests, book catalog management, and admin checks.
frontend/src/hooks/useVoiceSearch.ts: Custom hook wrapping the Web Speech API for voice recognition, managing listening state, transcript capture, and error handling with browser compatibility checks.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom botanical color palette (Pistachio Mist, Leaf Green, Sage, etc.) in OKLCH format, supporting both light and dark modes with utility classes for custom colors.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient provider for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, persisting, and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage integration for parameter persistence.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending default theme with custom botanical colors (leaf-green, sage, pistachio-mist), container settings, animations, and plugins for typography and container queries.
project_state.json: Project metadata for 'Kitabi Keeda' second-hand bookstore website with Pistachio Mist theme, tracking implemented features including authentication, book catalog, search, voice/image search, and sell-your-book functionality.
